[[Jin's Hornbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Jin the Skull Bow]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sunqua Vale]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 10-16 (Requires 5 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +10%
:[[Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Bleeding]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +15

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a [[perfect]] technical version for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
